description: This file is a React functional component implementing a modal dialog for displaying detailed information about a recommendation, including tabs for overview, impacted resources, cost impact, execution plan, and history. It manages focus trapping, accessibility, adaptive mode with plan computation, and user interactions such as running an optimization or closing the modal.
